about.title: About Print 8
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner for professional printing.
about.story: Print 8 is a company dedicated to high-quality printing and personalized products. With modern equipment and experience, we turn your ideas into reality — from simple business cards to complex gift sets.
about.missionText: To provide accessible, quality printing services with a focus on customer satisfaction and fast delivery.
about.qualityDesc: Every project gets our full attention.
about.trustDesc: Pay on delivery — no risk for you.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Get in touch — we'll respond as soon as possible.
contact.name: Full name

payment.a: We work exclusively with payment on delivery. You order online and pay when you receive the product.

formats.q: What file formats do you accept?
formats.a: We accept PDF, JPG, and PNG. For best results, use at least 300 DPI.

delivery.a: Standard delivery is 3–5 business days. For urgent orders, contact us.

custom.q: Can I create my own design?
custom.a: Yes! Use our design studio or upload your file when ordering.

minimum.a: It depends on the service. Business cards minimum is 100 pieces, t-shirts — 1 piece.
